cases.source_title: SWAP: a Guide to Overwatch 2 Counters

call.how: Stay on Zarya on Lijiang Tower Control Center.

cases.reason: Two soft counters are not enough to swap when the map is small and good for Zarya and bad for those DPS. His rule of 3.5: hard counter 2, bad map 1.5, soft counter 1; consider swapping at 3.5 or more.
cases.notes: Worked example in a counter guide, not a live match.

cases.source_title: SWAP: a Guide to Overwatch 2 Counters

call.how: Stay on Ashe on Junkertown first or third point and position well.

cases.reason: Ball and Tracer struggle to reach a well-positioned Ashe there, so the counter is softer than it looks.
cases.notes: Worked example in a counter guide, not a live match.

cases.source_title: Grandmaster Zarya/DVA Coaching (the 6v6 Tank Experience)

call.how: The swap to D.Mon is fine, but the real fix is retaking map control (move left or main).

cases.reason: He likes D.Va into Cass, Junk and Hog, but D.Mon is good on this flat map that needs no verticality; the swap does not fix the map-control problem.
cases.notes: 6v6 match; my_team lists only the heroes the player named at 57:00.

cases.source_title: Grandmaster Tracer/Shion Coaching (Coaching Sunshinebread 2.0)

call.how: The swap to Shion is fine; keep fixing lane discipline and engage timing.

cases.reason: Shion suits this open map and feels good against Pharah, but it will not solve her problems (crossing lanes, engaging before the tank).
cases.notes: Enemy Zenyatta and Juno are mentioned at 35:18 to 40:20; the player's tank is a Doomfist (40:33).

cases.source_title: Masters Wrecking Ball/Junkrat Coaching (Hit the Recliner)

call.how: Stay on Junkrat; respect the Sojourn rail and keep creating space.

cases.reason: He thinks Reaper is terrible into Junkrat, so the enemy swap helps you.
cases.notes: The enemy earlier ran Tracer, Kiriko and Lucio (47:37).

cases.source_title: Debunking Overwatch's Most Misleading Advice

call.how: Do not tunnel the Reinhardt just because Ramattra counters him; take a position with cover first, then pressure whatever is convenient from it.

cases.reason: Spilo mocks the clip's 'Ramattra counters Rein' logic: chasing the tank at the expense of position gets the Ramattra killed. Position first, target second (24:47 to 25:40).
cases.notes: Spilo reviewing a viewer clip about target priority. This is a how-to-play call, not a swap call.

cases.source_title: This Is Why You're Losing on Tank | Overwatch 2 VOD REVIEW (Rialto)

call.how: Do not swap to Roadhog here; play behind the cart and save hooks for later in the map.

cases.reason: First point on Rialto is a poor Hog map, and Orisa plus a damage-boosted Bastion make it hard to get close; Orisa, Ana and Mauga are big Hog counters.
cases.notes: The player did swap to Roadhog; the coach disagrees with it (13:40 and 21:26).
